context: Anti-patterns: no shared writable mounts between concurrent worktree containers; do not document container machine or any feature GATE 1 struck; do not promise Claude Desktop parity anywhere.
description: Ship docs/desktop-codex.md: the verified end-to-end flow (setup-ssh.sh -> agent-run.sh --agent codex --persistent -> codex login device-auth inside container -> Codex App Settings/Connections -> select /projects/<repo> -> app-server session), including alpha caveat and apple/container#919 caveat. GUARDRAIL: every documented step must have been executed on the Mini during this item - no aspirational steps; screenshots or transcripts for both the Codex Desktop session and the VS Code claude session are the completion evidence.
